entry.title: Virginia Capital Trail, November 9
entry.content:
From Virginia Capital Trail



🌳 Help shape the future of outdoor recreation in Virginia!

From the trails we ride and walk to the parks we explore and rivers we enjoy, Virginia’s outdoor spaces mean something special to all of us. 🚲⛺ Now’s your chance to help shape what comes next!

Virginia is developing its first-ever Outdoor Recreation Strategic Plan, and Virginia’s new Director of Outdoor Recreation, Heather Barrar, wants to hear from YOU! 🗣 What do you love about Virginia’s outdoor spaces? What would make them even better? What’s still needed in your community? 🌄

Did you know outdoor recreation contributes $14.4 billion to Virginia’s economy and supports more than 126,000 jobs? 🤩 Your input can help make sure the future of outdoor recreation reflects the needs of communities across the Commonwealth.

Please take a few minutes to complete the survey before it closes on November 18th. Every voice matters when it comes to protecting and improving the places we love. 🚶🏼‍♀️🏃🏿‍♂️🚴🏾‍♀️

🔗 naturalresources.virginia.gov/outdoor/virginia-outdoor-recreation-listening-tour-survey

🏷️ #virginiaisfortraillovers #gooutside #virginiatrails #virginiaisforoutdoorlovers #virginiaoutdoors

entry.title: Virginia Capital Trail, November 7
entry.content:
From Virginia Capital Trail









Our Fall Appeal mailing is on its way, thanks to an incredible group of volunteers and board members who rolled up their sleeves and handwrote nearly 2,000 personal messages. ✍🏾 That’s a lot of love for the Trail... and a lot of aching hands! 😅

📬 Watch your mailbox for a special note from our Trail community!

Whether it’s supporting the Trail we know and love or helping make the next 7.5 miles into Williamsburg a reality, your generosity makes a difference. Thank you for being part of this amazing Trail community! 💙💚

Every mile and every gift helps move the Trail forward!
✨ virginiacapitaltrail.org/donate-today or 🔗 in bio!

entry.title: Virginia Capital Trail, November 6
entry.content:
From Virginia Capital Trail

















Looking for Saturday plans? 👀 Our friends at Peace Hill Farm are hosting their annual Fall Festival this 📅 Saturday from 10 am to 4 pm. Located just 7 miles from MM 15 in Charles City, they’re pulling out all the stops for a fun-filled day on the farm! 🐄

Enjoy live music 🎶, vendors 💐, farm walks, games, and plenty of local shopping! 🛍️ Browse handcrafted goods, including jewelry, ornaments, and artisan gifts, and enjoy farm-fresh gelato 🍨, charcuterie, sausage, fresh honey 🐝, Latin cuisine, local wines 🍷, and craft beers 🍺. Plus, plenty of cute farm animals to visit! 🐑

Even better? Admission is FREE! 🥳 Check out some of the local vendors:

Heirloom Pewter Studio
Nobska Craftsmen
Udder Nonsense Creamery
Bodhi Bee Flourishing Farms
La Lavande Charcuterie & Grazing
Thistle & Thyme Apothecary
Sparrowhurst Flower Farm
Don Chido
Prestige Worldwide Curated Foods VA

Make a day of it, explore the 100-acre farm, support local makers, and add a little fall festivity to your #CapTrailAdventures!

🏷️ #peacehillfarm #virginiacapitaltrail #fallfestival #explorecharlescity

entry.title: Virginia Capital Trail, November 6
entry.content:
From Virginia Capital Trail




⚠️ TRAIL ALERT Update: The water has receded! There is still a little mud and residue left behind, so please stay alert, watch your step, and proceed slowly. Stay safe!

Flooding has been reported on the Capital Trail just west of Four Mile Creek Trailhead, near MM 41, where I-295 crosses the Trail. This section is between Four Mile Creek Park and Doran Road.

Other sections of the Capital Trail may also have standing water, mud, and debris following today’s storm. Please use extra caution and avoid the flooded section.

📸 @virginiadot

🏷️ #captrailalert #virginiacapitaltrail

entry.title: Virginia Capital Trail, November 6
entry.content:
From Virginia Capital Trail







🎨 COMMUNITY THURSDAY: Get Creative in Charles City!

Looking for a little inspiration (and maybe a little paint)? 👨🏾‍🎨 Join us in welcoming Just Ceramics, the newest addition to Market 5 in Charles City, opening Saturday, November 7! 🎉

The grand opening kicks off a full week of creative fun, activities, and special deals. 🛍 Stop in to meet the team, explore the studio, learn about the kiln process, and try your hand at something creative! 🤔

📍 11601 John Tyler Memorial Highway, Charles City
📅 Grand Opening Week: November 7 - 13
⏰ 10 am - 6 pm

We love seeing new businesses bring fresh energy, creativity, and opportunities to the communities along the Virginia Capital Trail. Welcome to the Trail, Just Ceramics! 💙💚
